verdict.rationale: Paychex Flex is a SaaS payroll platform with a public developer API, so an official CLI is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence documents only a REST API with OAuth 2.0, use cases and a 'Get Started' tool kit, and never mentions a command-line tool. A REST API is a developer building block, not a CLI, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
